verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs index explicitly links a canonical, downloadable OpenAPI schema at /openapi/developer-api.json, alongside a generated plain-text API reference and a Developer MCP server that exposes the OpenAPI schemas. An independent live probe confirms the URL returns HTTP 200 with a parseable OpenAPI v1 document covering 174 paths. Every element of the story is backed by first-party docs and hands-on corroboration.
